description:
A collection of Active Directory Tools to streamline Active Directory

Active Directory Pro Toolkit is an easy to use Active Directory Tools that makes managing Active Directory fast, easy and efficient. Automate tasks that are consuming your time and resources.
New Features
- User Management and Computer Management: added checkboxes to the results grid so several objects can be selected at once, with Disable, Enable and Delete for the selection. Works for users, groups and computers. Objects protected from accidental deletion are reported together and asked about once, and anything that fails is listed by name.
Bug Fixes
- Computer Management: deleting a computer no longer clears the whole results grid. The search is re-run instead, so the remaining results stay on screen.
